tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Void is pure black (as in the faction intro and codex site); Paper is the off-white print/terminal-label ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, list rows. Separate from bg with a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, selected-but-inactive tabs, input wells.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules, grid lines, panel dividers. Not for control borders (too weak).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, crop/registration marks, table frames. ≥3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg/surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, mono labels, metadata, timestamps. ≥4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Secondary identity green (from the codex site). Brand bars, splash accents, a quiet second green behind acid. Never a state, never a button fill, never adjacent to acid.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and marks on brand fills (both themes).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand green as text or strokes on bg/surface. Paper swaps to a deep green to clear 4.5:1.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Rare exception, closer to the UESC side of the setting than to CyAc. One deliberate contrast moment per surface at most (an opposing-faction panel, a single data bar set). Fill in Void; never a default background or accent.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and marks on cobalt fills (both themes).

tokens.name: cobalt-text
tokens.usage: Cobalt as text or strokes on bg/surface. Void lifts it to a periwinkle to clear 4.5:1; Paper uses full cobalt.

tokens.name: acid
tokens.usage: Primary accent. The colour CyAc is known by: hero blocks, primary action fills, active state, selection, focus on Void. Fill only in Paper; use acid-text for lime-as-text there.

tokens.name: on-acid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on acid fills (both themes).

tokens.name: on-acid-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, leaders and metadata on acid grounds (AcidGround, poster panels). 7.9:1 on acid.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px outside the control. Acid on Void; ink-black on Paper, where lime fails 3:1 against the ground.

tokens.name: acid-text
tokens.usage: Acid as text or 1–2px strokes on bg/surface. Paper swaps to a deep olive to clear 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: Hostile/alert/destructive fills and badges. Darker than caution so the two read apart without hue.

tokens.name: pulse-text
tokens.usage: Alert text and error messages on bg/surface.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning fills, timers running out, hazard banding. Lighter than pulse; pair with a label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: caution-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on bg/surface.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Info, friendly/neutral data, links in data-dense views, secondary chart series.

tokens.name: cyan-text
tokens.usage: Info text and links on bg/surface.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on pulse, caution and cyan fills.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark and the design system's own header. Inter Bold, set exactly 'CyAc' (mixed case), never caps, never ModeNine. Scale freely; 48px is the reference size.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen max. Hero titles, wordmark, big numerals. ALWAYS CAPS (text-transform: uppercase). ModeNine is single-weight: never fake-bold, never tighten (pixel stems collide).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section heroes, modal titles, big stat readouts. ALWAYS CAPS (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heads and panel titles. ALWAYS CAPS. Short: 1–3 words.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Card headers, tab labels, button text. ALWAYS CAPS. The smallest ModeNine size.

styles.name: serif-accent
styles.usage: Rare editorial interruption: lore pull-quotes, a single word in a hero. Never UI chrome.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Containment field nominal. Proceed to exfil point C.
styles.usage: Default running text, descriptions, settings copy. Functional first.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Markings, index codes, field labels, metadata strips. Caps. 11px is the floor for any text.

styles.name: label-tracked
styles.usage: Broadcast captions: centred, caps, often bracketed, floating in empty black. One line, one per screen. Signature lines under the wordmark.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Readouts, counters, prices. Tabular mono; zero-pad to fixed width so numbers don't jitter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gap, label-to-value in a marking.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips/badges, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding (horizontal), card padding on dense screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutter of the 12-col grid, pattern pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breaks, page margin on desktop, block module for graphic compositions.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: panels, cards, buttons, inputs, blocks.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Only where a hard corner aliases badly at small sizes: checkboxes, tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and live indicators only. If it isn't a dot, it's square.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, grid.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Control borders on focus, registration marks, underline of active tab.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Signal bars: the leading edge of an active row, hazard frames.
